gaps.sentence: He denied ___ the money, but nobody believed him.
I look forward to ___ you at the reunion.
gaps.explanation: 'To' is a preposition here, so the gerund follows.

gaps.sentence: You risk ___ your licence if you drink and drive.

gaps.explanation: Negative infinitive: promised not to be late — 'not' goes before 'to'.

gaps.sentence: We mustn't miss ___ this exhibition — it ends on Sunday.
I was made ___ the dustbin lorry at six in the morning.
gaps.explanation: In the passive, make takes the to-infinitive: was made to wait.

gaps.sentence: Don't forget ___ the plants while we're away.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do something you should do.

gaps.sentence: She forgot ___ the email, so she sent it twice.
gaps.explanation: forget + -ing = lose the memory of a past action (she did send it).
